scope_note: These controls collect technical design evidence only. Applicability and legal compliance require review by the controller, data protection officer, or qualified counsel.

controls.title: Data protection by design and by default
controls.objective: Use identity-based access and restrictive defaults as design evidence.

checks.description: The application uses a user-assigned managed identity.
Microsoft Foundry local authentication is disabled.
Azure AI Search local authentication is disabled.

controls.title: Security of processing
controls.objective: Collect evidence for encrypted transport, access control, and monitoring.

checks.description: Container Registry administrative credentials are disabled.
Application Insights is provisioned for operational telemetry.

controls.title: Data protection impact assessment
controls.objective: Require a DPIA decision record before processing personal data that may create high risk.

checks.description: A version-controlled DPIA assessment template exists.
